applies_why: This judge text declares Isaiah 7:14 UNDERDETERMINED by treating its two answered senses as leaving the matter open, which K-S2 governs.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand. Weighed: Isaiah 7:14's virgin/young-woman wording and prophetic application are two senses that must both stand, barring UNDERDETERMINED; or the judge merely reports that different rounds addressed different arguments without using the two-sense verse as a ground.
why: The judge treats the two-sense Isaiah 7:14 issue as open and labels it UNDERDETERMINED, when K-S2 says such a verse is not open and both senses stand.
